name: LangBot
description: Platform for building LLM-powered instant-messaging bots and agents on Discord, Telegram, Slack, LINE, WeChat, Lark and others.
whatItDoes: Creates chat bots with multi-turn dialogue, tool calling, multimodal input, streaming replies and a built-in knowledge base. One code base serves many messaging platforms.
howItWorks: A Python service connects platform adapters to LLMs and integrates with external agent platforms such as Dify. It is brought up with Docker Compose from the repository's docker directory.
